title: Book the BarbadosCottage in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach Vacation Rentals – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Welcome to Barbados Cottage – truly a home away from home, and a place to experience the simple, sophisticated lifestyle best found at the beach. Click to book this beautiful rental today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Barbados Cottage. When you enter this two bedroom, two and a half bathroom cottage, you’ll find that no detail has been overlooked. Designed by architect Doug Luke, who also designed Rosemary Beach’s Barbados Pool, the home boasts of beautiful craftsmanship and carpentry.

Enjoy Kingsbridge Park as you sit on the front porch with your morning coffee. Just inside, you’ll find a spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Ample seating is provided with a kitchen table and separate dining table. Windows throughout the first floor and high, cypress ceilings provide natural light and an open, airy feel. Just off the kitchen is a half bath with a pedestal sink and a laundry area with a stackable washing machine and dryer. Moving into the living area, you’ll find plush couches and comfortable chairs. Sit back and watch a movie on the large flat-screen television while listening to the sounds of the courtyard fountain just outside.

At the top of the stairs, you’ll come to a loft room with a built in bunk bed, which makes perfect sleeping accommodations for children. Just down the hallway is the master bedroom –a large, open room with a beachy, laid-back feeling. Just off the master bedroom is a balcony with beautiful Bahamian shutters that give the home a Caribbean atmosphere. The balcony has ample seating and a large hammock for napping outdoors. The master bedroom has a private bathroom with two pedestal sinks and a large shower and bathtub combination.

Make your way down the hallway to the guest bedroom where you will find a king size bed and French doors that open up to the balcony that is shared with the master bedroom. The guest room is decorated in whites and blues and has plenty of windows providing natural light. The second floor also has a shared bathroom with a glassed-in shower.

If you’re looking to getaway in what truly feels like a home away from home, look no further than Barbados Cottage. Spend your days at the beach and your evenings relaxing outside on the porch with friends and family. Let the children play in the park and neighboring courtyard while you have a drink on the front porch swing.

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY
